SD39-X01.name: The NobleDragoon Nu-Siegfried
SD39-X01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Twinkle Equip] (When Advents)
Target a family, and you can discard cards from your decktop until a Brave card with the targeted family is discarded. When you've done so, summon that card without paying the cost.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects. At the end of the battle, once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

SD39-010.name: Glorious-Flugel
SD39-010.effect:
When this Brave card is discarded from your deck, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[When Braved] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, when braved with a "Sheep"-named Spirit, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

SD39-001.name: SD0-L9
SD39-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When you stack a card via [Advent], put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

SD39-009.name: The GloryWarrior O-Superia
SD39-009.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded from your deck, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By returning an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand, during this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked.

OBLI-GUARD.name: The NobleOrder Obli-Guard
OBLI-GUARD.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Red/Yellow
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Yellow Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, this Spirit can block while exhausted.

SD39-003.name: The NobleOrder Soldier-Azure
SD39-003.effect:
When this Spirit card is discarded from your deck, you can summon it without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

SD39-007.name: The NobleOrder WhiteFlameMachineGod Loge
SD39-007.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Armed Machine & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Purple/White/Yellow/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White/Yellow/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

SD39-008.name: The ProtectionGodKing Glorious-Sheep Type-F
SD39-008.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Machine Beast/Armed Machine & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can discard three cards from your decktop. Add any amount of "Armed Machine" family Spirit cards among them as pre-Advent cards to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life would be reduced by the opponent, by discarding one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards, your Life wouldn't be reduced.

SD39-011.name: The TwinkleDragonGunblade Guns-Balmung
SD39-011.effect:
This card/Brave doesn't count towards the total number of Braves that your "Sieg"-named Spirit can brave with.

[LV1] [Reload]
You can [Advent] onto this Spirit-condition Brave. When you [Advent] onto this Brave, you can brave this pre-Advent card to that Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
While braved to a Spirit with [Advent], this Spirit can't be blocked.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1622.name: The Valkyrie Schwertlaute
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1622.effect:
[Burst: After Spirits/Braves are summoned via an opposing effect]
Return every opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

SD39-005.name: The WhiteSearcher WG-7
SD39-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Brave card, and a Spirit card with [Advent] to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit gains +3000 BP. Also, when you would [Advent], this Spirit can become Cost 6.

SD39-014.name: Balmung Shot
SD39-014.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Then, you can separate as many braved Braves you control. For each Brave separated by this effect, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. This effect can't be used during Main Step.

SD39-012.name: Das Rheingold
SD39-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
(When Summoned) effects of Spirit with families other than "Armed Machine" can't activate.

[LV2] (Opposing End Step)
If your Life wasn't reduced this turn, either draw a card, or put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

SD39-013.name: Rampart Wall
SD39-013.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent]
You can return a Spirit card in your Trash that was depleted/destroyed when this Burst activates to the Hand. When you've done so, you can summon from your Hand either a Brave card or an "Armed Machine" family Spirit card, without paying the cost. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step.
